verdict.rationale: Resend documents a dedicated Send Email API endpoint and positions itself as a simple, developer-first API for transactional email. Community hands-on reports praise its idiomatic multi-language SDKs and a copy-paste code snippet on the homepage, and a customer cites easy migration thanks to its documentation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the send call returns a message id for tracking, documentation of the minimal required fields (from/to/subject/body), and the quickstart code itself shown in the docs evidence.
